You get the moment's text with its neighbours, the depiction rules, the section cast (id, name, hasForm), the plan's selected cast ids (`present`), its seven scene fields, any OWNER LOOK CONSTRAINTS that rendering will use, and the canon of the selected entries. Report only clear problems that a careful reader would agree with, and return an empty list when the plan is a reasonable illustration of the moment. Do not report preferences, small omissions or other valid readings. Return only JSON.
The text decides who is in the scene; canon decides how they look; the scene plan decides this moment's place, time, light, clothing and action. Owner look constraints, when given, are binding.
Kinds:
- unselected_figure: a section cast entry (a person, group, place, object, or a no-form presence shown as its effect) is clearly depicted in a scene field but its id is not in present. Use its id.

message.content: {"focusQuote":"struck the Philistine in his forehead","instant":"David, slinging stone in hand, has just released the stone as Goliath staggers forward and falls face-down in the dust of the valley.","selectedCast":[{"entryId":"david_son_of_jesse_king_of_israel","evidence":"David put his hand in his bag, took a stone and slung it"},{"entryId":"goliath","evidence":"struck the Philistine in his forehead... he fell on his face to the earth"},{"entryId":"valley_of_elah","evidence":"open valley between two opposing hillsides with rocky ground"},{"entryId":"philistines","evidence":"the Philistine... came near to meet David"}],"primarySubject":"Young David, slight and in a simple shepherd's tunic, arm extended after the release of his sling.","action":"Goliath, struck on the forehead, collapses forward onto his face in the dust while David stands firm.","setting":"Open Valley of Elah between rocky hillsides, scrub and a shallow dry streambed.","secondaryElements":"Goliath in heavy bronze armor and greaves; Philistine and Israelite ranks watching from either hillside; a shield dropped in the dust; a leather pouch at David's side.","mood":"Tense, stunned hush turning toward hope; grave and restrained rather than triumphant.","timeOfDay":"Late morning, clear dry hot sky with a light haze over the hills, bright hard midday sunlight from high above.","composition":"Wide valley view with David in the mid-ground on the left, Goliath's falling body centered in the foreground, opposing armies on the hillsides framing the scene."}
